short_description: Luto is a psychological horror experience where you take on the role of someone unable to leave their home. Every attempt to escape will lead you deeper into the unknown, where nothing is as it seems and everything will test your senses.
steam_categories: Single-player; Steam Achievements; Partial Controller Support; Family Sharing
